rules.slot_order: least loss first: an era set that has a kept twin (or is the throwback's own original), then a retail 20xx Alternate, then an orphan kit, then a new index past the spare (append, phase 2); never a style a historic team, a moment or the m1 spare uses
rules.kits: a style has a home kit (h) and a road kit (a); one design goes in both unless the set is a home/road pair
rules.labels: a planned style reads '2026  Alternate n' (n in the order the game cycles); the Rams keep 1-3
rules.tiers: 1 worn or planned in 2026; 2 in the 2026 closet but no 2026 game found; 3 a pants or socks combo of the primary set
rules.build_types: derive: the team's shipped 2026 kit recoloured (helmet, pants, socks, jersey base); modernize: the slot's own retail art (the same uniform) with the 2026 marks; new: a new design from photos
